result.question: Qual a distribuição e percentual de internações em UTI por dia da semana?
result.gold_sql: SELECT t.dia_semana, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes_uti, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) AS pct_total FROM internacoes i JOIN tempo t ON i."DT_INTER" = t.data WHERE i."VAL_UTI" > 0 GROUP BY t.dia_semana ORDER BY t.dia_semana;
result.generated_sql: SELECT t."dia_semana", COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes_uti, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) AS percentual FROM internacoes i JOIN tempo t ON i."DT_INTER" = t."data" WHERE i."VAL_UTI" > 0 GROUP BY t."dia_semana" ORDER BY t."dia_semana";
